## Football effect

Jones-Drew carried 22 times for 93 yards and caught three passes before and after the injury was logged, including the 10-yard access run and the 7-yard Power run that set up the winning field goal in overtime. On the projection he misses the Monday review and the early Washington practice week; his availability follows the medical staff's communication at the September 8 reassessment, not the projection. Anderson and Grimes are the chart's carried order behind him; no role change follows and no football finding attaches to the instruction.
